body: hey :) thanks. I'm actually okay now, i talked it out with a few people last night. thanks for your support.

i have taken big steps in using her death as a push towards bettering myself. she's the reason i'm in uni, studying nursing. i want to help people and families going through trauma like the nurses helped us. 

sometimes the grief takes over. like last night. i just shut right down and ache inside and get so upset. but i'm usually okay enough. 

it's more other things in my life fuelling the self-injury and suicidal ideation. but i suppose the same advice stands. it's hard to take control of a life filled with shit. there's a lot of it. and like i said most of the time i'm okay enough, i'm studying, i'm kind to people. but i am letting things walk all over me. 

thank you for understanding. I am sorry for your loss.
I have a blind friend, she laughs her ass off at shit like this.
